nodeData.topic: HH Bhakti Padma Saurabha Pracharaka Swami
nodeData.note: Classes by HH Bhakti Padma Saurabha Pracharaka Swami, known before he accepted sannyasa as HG Kamal Lochan Prabhu (Kamala-locana Dasa), a disciple of HH Gopal Krishna Goswami. Each series bubble is a door into that series; inside, each class is a door into its own map. Notes are our own summaries of the classes; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube. Mapped with his agreement (confirmed by KKD, 24 Nov 2026). Review in progress.
